lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap via the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset represents approximately 475.1 thousand mapped buildings with structural metadata (construction type, levels, materials, addresses) derived from crowdsourced VGI contributions, with coverage estimated at 28% of total buildings in the region.
